method.formula: deadlineMs = max(500, 2 x nearestRankP95(uncensored ok rows pooled across runs))
method.censoring: ok=false with 'timed out waiting for worker message' = censored (true value > probe ceiling, excluded from p95); other failures = errors (excluded); all retained as raw rows
method.p95: nearest-rank (1-based) over uncensored ok rows pooled across runs
method.fallbackClause: a case with no uncensored ok row in any run keeps the existing 5000ms with the ledger sentence "no baseline measured; current constant retained pending defect fix" (hub ruling, option d)
method.standingInstruction: when a later derivation produces a baseline for a fallback case, the fallback entry is replaced by the derived deadline in the same change
method.gateSensitivity: derived deadlines TIGHTEN the fast majority relative to the former blanket 5000ms; this is a deliberate gate-sensitivity change, not a loosening

generatedFrom.stealNote: stealPct = share of CPU-time delta taken by the hypervisor during each run (/proc/stat, two samples per run). Deadlines are environment-relative: derived under the recorded loadavg AND steal; re-derive on a different environment rather than reusing this table.
